name: GameFabric
what_it_is: A developer-first multiplayer server orchestration platform that runs game server fleets on bare metal, cloud or both under one API and dashboard.
platforms: 22 bare metal regions across five continents; cloud via GameFabric Cloud (managed, on Google Cloud) or bring your own AWS, Azure or GCP accounts.
pricing: Individual pricing tailored to the studio; no price amounts published, demo request required.
notable: The site navigation carries a Hathora link, and hathora.dev redirected to gamefabric.com when checked
Page says it is built on 25 years of operating game servers in production
Page claims savings of as much as 60% on server fees

facts.fact: The GameFabric homepage describes an orchestration layer for studios shipping multiplayer titles, deployable on bare metal, cloud or both under one API, one dashboard and one fleet.
The homepage lists 22 bare metal regions across five continents and cloud options through GameFabric Cloud on Google Cloud or bring-your-own AWS, Azure or GCP accounts.
The pricing page offers individual pricing tailored to each studio with a demo request and no price amounts.
The pricing page claims savings of as much as 60% on server fees by scaling from bare metal to cloud, and describes SteelShield UDP and TCP DDoS protection.
